items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: he used to do that for all them guys and like I said Chief Rye and all them big guys

ctx.x: But she, you mentioned, talking about Lula again, since you say you knew her, well I never knew her at all. She was, you say brown skinned, I thought she was very light. No she wasn't. It was the Octaroom, wasn't she? No she wasn't. She wasn't that light. No. The girls were lighter. Oh yeah, all the girls were lighter. They were lighter.

I thought Lula was that light too. No, she wasn't. You didn't know. Not the Lula I seen. Yeah. You know what I mean? But she had the blonde hair. She had a blonde wig and I had about that long. I didn't know I had hair. 15 inches long. Well what was the natural color of her hair? I don't know. Well you know, if you have bad hair, well you know it's the same color as anybody that's got that hair, you know? I see. And my uncle just lived right around the corner from Lula Weiss and he was a bottle man. Was what? He…
So you planned, not to cut your album out there, do you remember those bands that played in the dance halls in those days? In the district?
